content:
**Adrenaline** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Gain damage per kill while on a Kill Streak.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Gain +10% damage per kill while on a Kill Streak (Max 10). | 00397CBA | 

Before update 60, the perk had 5 ranks that provided +6%/+7%/+8%/+9%/+10% damage (up to 6x) for 30s per kill. Duration was refreshed with kills.
